messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hey there! So, I have this order—W7209932, I think? I got a blue v-neck T-shirt, small, polyester, but I was hoping to swap it for something a bit different. Also, I have a gift card I want to use, but I’m not sure how that works with exchanges. Can you help me figure this out?

Yes—I can help with that. First, I need to authenticate you so I can look up your order **W7209932** and your payment method.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Also, about how a **gift card** works for an **exchange**: if you choose a gift card as the payment method, then **any price difference (extra charge or refund)** is handled via the gift card **immediately**, and the gift card must have **enough balance to cover any additional cost** for the new item. After that, we can request the exchange for items of the **same product type** (e.g., different color/size option), not a different product type.

Once you share your email (or name+ZIP), I’ll check your order status and the exact item options so we can proceed.

Oh, okay! I think my email is amelia.gonzalez4271@example.com. But just to be sure, do you need my ZIP code too, or is the email enough? Also, when you say “same product type,” does that mean I can’t change the material or style? I’m a little confused about what counts as the same product.

Great—**if you’re using your email**, I only need the email to authenticate you. **ZIP code isn’t required** in that case.

On “**same product type**”: it means the exchange must stay within the **same product category/product** (for you, that’s a **T-shirt**). You *can* swap to a different **variant option** of that same product (for example: different size/color/style option that’s still sold under the T-shirt product).

What you **can’t** do is exchange from one **product type** to another (e.g., **T-shirt → shoes**).

About **material/style**: if the material/style you want is offered as a **different option within the same T-shirt product**, then it should qualify as “same product, different option.” If it’s a different product category, it wouldn’t.

If you confirm the exchange is for the **T-shirt** only, I’ll now look up order **W7209932** and tell you which T-shirt options are available to swap to (and the payment difference handling with your gift card).

Okay, got it! Yes, I just want to swap the T-shirt for another T-shirt, but I want it in red, XXL, cotton, and crew neck instead of what I got. Is that all under the same product? And if there’s a price difference, can you just use my gift card for that? I’m not sure how much is on it, though.
